purpose: Measure actual generated answers and observed Book ingestion/retrieval/generation costs with a reproducible local endpoint; do not claim a complete native competitor-workflow comparison.

cohorts.interpretation: known retrieval regression data; first actual generation measurement for this experiment
external multi-hop diagnostic; base-model pretraining overlap is unknown

scoring: Existing fixed answer_eval normalized exact match and lexical token F1 on answerable questions; exact INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE abstention on unsupported questions. Labels stay evaluator-side. These lexical metrics are not semantic-judge scores or the official LoCoMo answer metric.
execution: Same fixed prompt and served artifact for all engines. Rotate engine order per query. Preserve failed/truncated/in-flight attempts and reported model identity/usage. Never replace real model outputs with fixtures. Keep raw upstream passages outside Git; publish per-query source/context/request/response hashes, answers, scores, usage and timing where licensing permits.
cost_boundary: Separate once-per-corpus ingestion/index/model load from per-query retrieval/packing/generation. Book does not use model summarization, so its configured summary phase has zero model calls. Missing native competitor observer/compression/follow-up phases remain unknown. Local server token counts are not provider bills and no electricity/dollar advantage is inferred.
limitations: One small quantized CPU model and two bounded cohorts cannot establish answer quality for other models, universal semantic memory, or broad domain generalization. Register any platform-driven server fallback before scoring and retain the original attempt.
